test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following city of India was a coastal settlement where ships unloaded goods from distant lands between 2200 and 1900 years ago?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arikamedu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arikamedu** is located in Puducherry.
 
• It was excavated in the **1940s**.
 
• It is famous for manufacturing the construction of amazing **bead ornaments and the glass beach site**. 
 
• A massive brick structure, which may have been a **warehouse**, was found at the site.
 
• It is also known for being an **archaeological site** in southern India.
 
• Potteries were found in the Mediterranean region such as Amphorae and stamped red glaze pottery known as Arretine Ware.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karaikal **is a meeting place of Western culture with the traditional and ancient Tanjavur culture.
 
• Karaikal is a major **port city** on the East Coast of India. This is the birthplace of **KaraikalAmmaiyar**. Karaikal is famous for its temples. The major attraction in the area is **Saneeswara Temple, Sri Kailasanathar Temple, Navagraha Temples and Ammaiyar Temple**.
 
• **Veerampattinam **is the largest coastal village in the union territory of Puducherry situated between Pondicherry and Cuddalore
 
• Veerampattinam village is famous for **Car Festival** celebrated here on the occasion of the six weeks long village temple (Sri Sengazhuneer Amman Temple).
 
• The French occupied **Yanam **in **1723**.
 
• Yanam had some commercial importance. It was a centre for the manufacture of salt and this salt constituted thje major part of the quantity imported by the French into the Bengal, region.
